svg.title: ROC: classification / best_model
svg.desc: ROC curves for cosine similarity and negative Euclidean distance. Larger scores mean the same identity.

g.text: 8805 verification pairs; positive label 1 = same identity
L2 normalization makes cosine and Euclidean rankings equivalent (up to numerical ties).
Selected thresholds are validation-calibrated / in-sample, not unbiased test operating points.
